purpose: Reproduce the fresh-database seed.sh path from CI after run 394 and verify optional role bootstrap and PostgreSQL readiness fixes.

ci_run.failure: After the fast-fail project was removed, a new database was started and seed.sh applied migrations without the optional kokonut_runtime and kokonut_worker_login role names. Migration 427 failed on a REVOKE for kokonut_runtime.

fix.role_bootstrap: Shared scripts/bootstrap-optional-roles.sql creates only absent runtime and worker-login placeholders as NOLOGIN, NOINHERIT, NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE, NOREPLICATION, and NOBYPASSRLS roles. Both seed.sh and verify-clean-bootstrap.sh run it before schema replay.
fix.readiness: Base and Kernel candidate PostgreSQL healthchecks and wait_for_postgres now require the final TCP listener. This avoids treating the PostGIS entrypoint's temporary Unix-socket-only initialization server as ready. seed.sh waits again after init.sql/extensions.sql before migrations.

isolated_replay.clickhouse: not started; seed script skipped its schema step
isolated_replay.directus: not started; seed script skipped permissions
isolated_replay.result: PostgreSQL schema migrations applied successfully; seed.sh completed.

limitations: The replay used an isolated disposable local database; it did not apply migrations to the Kernel candidate or legacy stack.
No curated seed, pilot data, provider call, or external integration ran.
